Here is a curated playlist for your warm summer afternoon backyard barbecue, blending upbeat country and reggae tracks to create a relaxed, social atmosphere:

1. "Watermelon Sugar" - Harry Styles (Reggae-infused pop vibe)
2. "Chicken Fried" - Zac Brown Band (Upbeat country classic)
3. "Three Little Birds" - Bob Marley & The Wailers (Essential reggae chill)
4. "Body Like a Back Road" - Sam Hunt (Modern country banger)
5. "Is This Love" - Bob Marley & The Wailers (Smooth reggae rhythm)
6. "Cruise" - Florida Georgia Line (Country-rock crossover hit)
7. "No Woman, No Cry" - Bob Marley & The Wailers (Laid-back classic)
8. "Wagon Wheel" - Darius Rucker (Upbeat, sing-along country)
9. "Jamming" - Bob Marley & The Wailers (Perfect for mingling)
10. "Tennessee Whiskey" - Chris Stapleton (Soulful country groove)

The longest river in the world is the Nile River.
